task_regime_scope: No goal coordinates or goal IDs in policy task text; one current target is presented at a time

strict_visual_control_contract.target_detection: current-frame RGB segmentation and rendered feature depth
strict_visual_control_contract.command_generation: measured visible-geometry 3D error with a normalized coupled actuation Jacobian

target_pose_usage: target world coordinates place the virtual marker and support independent post-run acceptance only; target inverse kinematics are not supplied to the visual controller or used to generate motion commands
episode_definition: one reset start pose, sequential navigation to the supplied targets, then stop or failure hold
scene_reset_scope: fresh Reference/MuJoCo scene for each method run; target marker and robot task are reset to this episode's scenario

stop_constraint.visual_controller: measured controllable 3D error within 8 um for 3 consecutive zero-command-velocity observations
stop_constraint.sampled_planners: rest-to-rest trajectory with zero endpoint velocity at every target
stop_constraint.independent_acceptance: all targets reached, per-target stop reports valid, final command velocity is zero
stop_constraint.scope: kinematic command validation; no hardware braking or tissue-contact validation

perception: simulated RGB + depth + geometry segmentation; calibrated fixed camera, RCM, needle and marker dimensions

expert_perception_privileges.visual_servo_fundus_feedback_scope: current-frame visible-geometry 3D feedback throughout; no equation-generated target path or analytic transfer
expert_perception_privileges.policy_exclusion: expert depth, segmentation, feature calibration and scene poses are not policy input fields
expert_perception_privileges.multi_target_scope: targets are presented sequentially; all methods share one script-selected order; this does not demonstrate a learned policy detecting or ordering multiple lesions

image_ablation.status: paired no-image inputs are exported; policy training/evaluation is not present in this repository
image_ablation.evaluation_requirement: compare the same policy/splits with and without RGB; report success, endpoint error, constraint failures, and occlusion-stratified performance
